# Sneat Club

Sneat Club is a home for community sports clubs, teams and members. Club management is being built on the Sneat platform, with specialist sports services alongside it.

- Product overview: https://sneat.club/
- Sports guides: https://sneat.club/sports/
- App preview: https://sneat.club/preview/
- Tech stack: https://sneat.club/about/tech-stack/
- Source: https://github.com/sneat-co/sneat-club
